request_payload.title: Zorevunersen in Children and Adolescents with Dravet Syndrome.

mentions.sentence: BACKGROUND: Dravet syndrome is a severe developmental and epileptic encephalopathy caused primarily by SCN1A haploinsufficiency.

candidates.label: SCN1A-related disorders (incl. Dravet syndrome)
candidates.summary: Gene-defined umbrella for conditions caused by variants in SCN1A (11 curated clinical entities in OMIM/Orphanet).

candidates.label: SCN2A-related disorders
synonyms: benign familial infantile epilepsy caused by mutation in SCN2A
candidates.summary: Gene-defined umbrella for conditions caused by variants in SCN2A (9 curated clinical entities in OMIM/Orphanet).

candidates.label: CDKL5 deficiency disorder
synonyms: developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 2, X-linked dominant
early infantile epileptic encephalopathy caused by mutation in CDKL5
candidates.summary: Gene-defined umbrella for conditions caused by variants in CDKL5 (4 curated clinical entities in OMIM/Orphanet).

candidates.label: GRIN2B-related disorders
synonyms: GRIN2B autosomal dominant non-syndromic intellectual disability
GRIN2B-related developmental delay, intellectual disability and autism spectrum disorder
candidates.summary: Gene-defined umbrella for conditions caused by variants in GRIN2B (3 curated clinical entities in OMIM/Orphanet).

candidates.label: CBL-related disorder
synonyms: Noonan syndrome-like disorder with or without juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia
Noonan syndrome-like disorder with juvenile myelomonocytic leukaemia
Noonan syndrome-like disorder with juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia
candidates.summary: Germline CBL changes cause a Noonan syndrome-like disorder with a predisposition to juvenile myelomonocytic leukaemia.

candidates.label: HRAS-related disorders (Costello syndrome)
synonyms: congenital myopathy with excess of muscle spindles
candidates.summary: Germline activating HRAS changes cause Costello syndrome: feeding problems, loose skin, heart disease, developmental delay and a raised tumour risk.

candidates.label: SLC6A1-related disorders

candidates.label: SYNGAP1-related disorders
synonyms: SYNGAP1 autosomal dominant non-syndromic intellectual disability
SYNGAP1 gene mutation linked to intellectual disability, schizophrenia and autism
candidates.summary: Gene-defined umbrella for conditions caused by variants in SYNGAP1 (2 curated clinical entities in OMIM/Orphanet).

candidates.label: IDS-related disorders (mucopolysaccharidosis type II, Hunter syndrome)
candidates.summary: X-linked deficiency of iduronate-2-sulfatase makes heparan and dermatan sulfate build up; the neuronopathic form also causes progressive cognitive decline.

candidates.label: IDUA-related disorders (mucopolysaccharidosis type I: Hurler, Hurler-Scheie, Scheie)
candidates.summary: Deficiency of alpha-L-iduronidase makes dermatan and heparan sulfate build up in many organs: coarse facial features, skeletal disease, heart and airway problem

mentions.sentence: The effects of zorevunersen, an antisense oligonucleotide designed to up-regulate NaV1.1 sodium channels, in patients with Dravet syndrome are not known.

candidates.label: Zorevunersen (STK-001, SCN1A TANGO antisense oligonucleotide)
candidates.summary: An antisense oligonucleotide designed to raise productive SCN1A (NaV1.1) expression; in phase 3 for Dravet syndrome.

candidates.label: Elsunersen (PRAX-222, SCN2A-targeting antisense oligonucleotide)
candidates.summary: An antisense oligonucleotide that lowers SCN2A expression, studied in early-onset gain-of-function SCN2A DEE.

candidates.label: Kv7 potassium channel openers (ezogabine / retigabine, XEN496)
candidates.summary: Drugs that open KCNQ2/KCNQ3 (Kv7) potassium channels, studied in KCNQ2 encephalopathy due to loss-of-function variants.

candidates.label: KCNT1-targeting antisense oligonucleotide (knockdown)
candidates.summary: Antisense oligonucleotides that lower KCNT1 expression; tested in mice and given investigationally to two infants.

candidates.label: Scn8a-lowering antisense oligonucleotide (preclinical)
candidates.summary: An antisense oligonucleotide that lowers Scn8a; protective in mouse models of SCN8A encephalopathy and of Dravet syndrome.
